brand_identity.name: Apollo Builders
brand_identity.core_directive: Avoid AI template-slop. No generic shadow cards, rounded bubbles, or standard gradients. Think 'Award-winning architecture firm'. Layout must rely on negative space, clipped framing, and precise typography.

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' & Editorial Hybrid. High contrast between elegant serif headings and sterile, precise sans-serif body text.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-light tracking-tighter leading-[1.1]

rules: NEVER center-align paragraphs. Use left alignment for readable content.
Use 'font-light' or 'font-normal' for Fraunces to emphasize the editorial look. Do not default to bold.
Add 'tracking-tighter' to large headings to maintain sophisticated tension.

colors.strategy: Strict restraint. Let the photography provide the color. UI is structural.
rules: No generic gradients. Use solid colors. The only exception is the subtle navy gradient overlay for the hero image.
Never use pure black #000000. Use text_dark or primary_navy.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous negative space. Elements must breathe.
spacing_and_layout.scale: Use 2x standard Tailwind spacing (e.g., py-24, py-32 for sections, gap-12, gap-16 for grids).
grids: Asymmetrical Bento: Offset images and text blocks. Do not make perfect 50/50 splits everywhere.
Clipped Frames: Images should not have rounded corners (rounded-none). They should act as structural blocks within the grid.
Inline Rows: Trust points and metrics should sit in a clean row, separated by thin borders or dots, not inside boxed cards.

motion_and_interaction.scrolling: Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. Mandatory for the premium feel.

animations.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal (staggered translateY with overflow-hidden wrapper).
animations.scroll_reveal: Subtle fade + Y translation (y: 20, opacity: 0 to 1, duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]).
animations.marquee: Slow, constant x-axis translation. Use Framer Motion or react-fast-marquee. Must feel editorial and deliberate, not frantic.
animations.hover_states: Images scale up slightly (1.03) inside an overflow-hidden clipped frame. Buttons use reverse contrast fill, no bouncy scales.

buttons.style: Sharp (rounded-none) or minimally rounded (rounded-sm). Bordered or solid fill. No shadows. No gradients.
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-primary_navy text-primary_navy hover:bg-primary_navy hover:text-neutral_white transition-colors

sections.content: Single background image with subtle navy gradient overlay (bg-primary_navy/40). Headline 'Welcome to Apollo Builders' using kinetic on-load reveal. One supporting line, one sharp CTA 'Get a Free Quote'. NO SLIDERS.
Short intro text. Trust points (Fully Insured, Fixed Price Quotes, etc.) aligned horizontally separated by interpuncts (·) or thin vertical lines. NO CARDS.
6-8 strong images using 'clipped frames' strategy. Asymmetrical grid. Hover reveals the 'After' image or transitions between states seamlessly without jarring jumps.

Alternating left/right large imagery with precise typography identifying locations (Drouin, Bentleigh East, etc.). Use clipping masks or distinct aspect ratios (e.g., 3:4 portrait mixed with 16:9 landscape).
Large editorial numbers (e.g., '01', '02') paired with oversized headings. Generous padding.
No default plugin icons. Use thin lines to connect stages, raw text, and simple dots/numbers. Minimalist and structural.
A single instance of oversized, outline or low-opacity text (e.g., 'CRAFTING MELBOURNE CUSTOM HOMES') panning slowly across the screen.
Use Shadcn Accordion but strip all borders except bottom. Use thin line separators. Title in Fraunces, body in Inter Tight.
No star ratings. Large serif quotation marks, elegant text setting. Minimalist attribution.
Solid primary_navy background, neutral_white text. Large call to action to Contact.

forms.style: Minimalist inputs. border-b only (flushed inputs) or very thin complete borders with rounded-none. Muted placeholder text.
forms.tech: Store in MongoDB + Resend for email notification.

data_management.projects_and_testimonials: Hardcoded in frontend as clean array/config objects inside constants/data.js or similar.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient contrast. Use subtle overlays or text-shadow.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for all framer-motion animations.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a premium architectural site, NOT a generic SaaS template.
DO NOT use Shadcn Card component if it retains its default rounded borders and shadows. Strip them out.
Ensure the hero is THIN (max 55vh). Do not use a full 100vh hero screen.
Apply Framer Motion for scroll-reveals (useInView) on every major section, but keep it elegant (slow fades/translations), no wild bouncing.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling at the root level.
Strictly adhere to the provided colors. Navy is the anchor. Backgrounds should largely be off-white or white.
Use the exact URLs provided for images. Fallback to similar structure if generating array.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic: no generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, or uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements and precise typography rather than heavy drop shadows.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use placeholder AI emoji characters for icons. Use lucide-react or phosphor-icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus).
Use 2-3x more spacing than default Tailwind padding.
Do not use complete transparent backgrounds for header menus over content.
